title: Junkluggers
tagline: Data-driven decision making and operational efficiency
summary: Reporting and data-processing workflows on AWS for a US service business: complex Redshift SQL, S3-to-Redshift loading, and Python report generation.
overview: A reporting engagement focused on turning large operational datasets into decision-ready reports for a US service business.
I wrote complex Amazon Redshift SQL, built Python workflows for processing and report generation, and set up data loading from Amazon S3 into Redshift, then tuned queries for speed and reliability.

points: Developed complex Amazon Redshift SQL queries for business reporting and analysis.
Extracted, transformed and organized data from large datasets to match reporting requirements.
Built Python backend workflows for data processing and report generation.
Implemented data-loading workflows using Amazon S3 and Redshift.
Optimized queries and data-processing operations to improve reporting efficiency and reliability.

achievements: Faster, more reliable reporting through query optimization.
